brief: music video ideas for my indie song about leaving home, about a minute
concept: One last night on the rooftop where they grew up, told backwards from dawn to dusk.
plan_outline: 1. WS · eye · static · city rooftop at dawn, cool blue · the singer alone among empty bottles, a packed suitcase (6 s, verse 1)
2. MCU · eye · push in · same rooftop · she sings to herself, wind in her hair (6 s)
3. WS · high · crane · same rooftop at night, fairy lights · friends dancing, blurred (5 s, pre-chorus: time runs back)
4. CU · eye · handheld · same rooftop at night · a friend laughing into camera (3 s)
5. MS · eye · track · same rooftop at golden hour · the friends arriving with a speaker (5 s, chorus)
6. ECU · eye · static · rooftop ledge · two hands, one with a friendship band, rest side by side (3 s)
7. EWS · eye · pull back · rooftop at sunset · the whole group small against the city skyline (6 s, the last chorus)
8. Repeat motifs on the repeated chorus: the band, the ledge, the skyline
why: Reverse chronology gives a simple story a hook: we see the ending first and wonder how she got there.
Light is the clock (dawn blue → night practicals → golden hour), so the time jumps read without titles.
Cuts follow the song: long verse shots, faster chorus cuts, motifs repeated on repeated sections.
Dancing groups are kept blurred and in the background; close shots are singles.
